title: Less monitoring changes the payoff
hook: Two stated cases: explore the expected sanction when detection falls.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the expected sanction when detection falls affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Net, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the expected sanction when detection falls in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
